knowledge.q: Who hosts the GTA 6 radio stations?
knowledge.text: According to Rockstar: Robyn and Alex Consani on Flash FM; Bad Bunny (El Martillo) and RaiNao (La Gata) on Cocoteo FM; Morgan Wallen (MW) and Lana Del Rey (Delta Dawne) on Back Country Radio, with reporter Mud Dog Mike; Burna Boy (Burna) and Palms Trax (Palmsy) on AfroBank FM; Kerry King and Tom Araya, of Slayer, on The Chamber 106.6; Trick Daddy and Trina on Dirty South Classics.

knowledge.q: Can you listen to the radio on foot in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: Yes, according to Rockstar (October 8, 2026): for the first time, you can also listen to the radio and on-demand podcasts on foot, with Jason’s or Lucia’s phone and earbuds, in addition to the car radio.

knowledge.q: What songs can you hear in the Extended Look?
knowledge.text: Fourteen licensed songs, from Birdman and Lil Wayne to Phil Collins, by way of Def Leppard, Depeche Mode and Cliff Richard. The press listed them with their timestamps; Rockstar hasn’t published the list.

knowledge.q: What is “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album”?
knowledge.text: The game’s official album, announced by Rockstar and Atlantic Records on September 17, 2026: 34 original tracks, coming out on November 19, 2026 with the game. Six tracks came out with the announcement, including those by Travis Scott, Yung Lean and Keith Richards; others followed, like “Flower in a Hurricane” by Justice on October 15.
